symptom: A balanced trial balance was reported as out of balance by a few hundred; 'Credit Accounts Payable 5,200' became 5 and 200.
trigger: A trial balance written inline with comma-formatted amounts.
fix: Split an inline account list only on a semicolon or a comma that is not a thousands separator: r";\s*|,(?!\d)".
avoid: splitting on every comma
treating a thousands separator as an account boundary

symptom: A trial balance written 'Debit Cash 12,500; Credit Capital 40,000' was read as an adjustment narrative and refused for a missing unadjusted trial balance.
trigger: The Dr/Cr marker placed before the account instead of after the amount.
fix: classify() treats a leading Debit/Credit/Dr/Cr marker plus an account and an amount as a trial balance; parse_rows strips the marker from the label and _side() reads Debit/Credit as D/C.
avoid: only recognising a marker after the amount
classifying every Debit/Credit list as adjustments

symptom: An entire trial balance on one semicolon-separated line collapsed into a single sentence label and was skipped.
trigger: Accounts separated by semicolons on one line.
fix: _line_pieces splits on a semicolon and on a Debit/Credit marker that starts a new account, so a preamble ending ': Debit Cash 12,500' does not swallow the first account.
avoid: splitting only on '. '
letting a preamble hide the first account

symptom: A 25,000 'Kitchen Equipment' debit was silently skipped, so the trial balance looked unbalanced by exactly that amount.
trigger: A qualifier word before a known account name.
fix: place() tries the label without its leading qualifier when the full label matches no rule, so 'Kitchen Equipment' places as equipment.
avoid: matching only the exact account name
dropping an unrecognised line without reporting it

symptom: A burst of 18 'could not reach the provider: TimeoutError' records filled the error list; the loop retried them as defects.
fix: The provider timeout is 120s (BP_LLM_TIMEOUT); statements._read_journal retries once on a transient error; transient causes are never written to the error list.
avoid: logging a timeout as a pipeline bug
fixing a provider outage with a code replay

symptom: The same failure was re-solved forever because every occurrence got a new error id.
trigger: The loop closing instances instead of causes.
fix: log_error writes one open record per message; the picker skips a cause already fixed or attended; resolve short-circuits a fixed cause without a model call.
avoid: creating a new id for an open duplicate
replaying a cause that already has a durable fix

symptom: A case failed with 'unemployment_rate is 0.0712986..., expected 0.0713' and similar rounded expectations.
trigger: A stored expectation written from a displayed (rounded) value.
fix: _same_number accepts the rounding of the actual to the expected's own decimal places (0.5 * 10^-d), with the exact 1e-9 rule otherwise.
avoid: comparing a display-rounded value at 1e-9
requiring the case to store full precision

symptom: Twelve tiles refused with 'Unknown capability: posthoc' (also paired, onesample, multicomp, logit, factorial, portfolioval, portfolioperf, scv, salesvar, accounts, abc).
trigger: A tile whose method is in the frozen core but has no catalogue entry in capabilities.ENTRIES.
fix: run_capability falls back to the selection row when capabilities.entry(key) raises, so a tile with a core method runs without a catalogue entry.
avoid: refusing a tile just because the catalogue has no row
assuming every core method has a capability entry

symptom: Case expectations named keys the method no longer returns (participation_rate, not_in_labour_force, unemployed_to_employed_ratio, consumer_minus_producer_surplus; percentage_change_quantity, percentage_change_price, price_elasticity_of_demand, revenue_1, revenue_2).
trigger: A method output renamed or removed while an authored case still pinned the old key.
fix: Reconcile the case expectation to the method's current outputs: rename participation_rate to labour_force_participation_rate and percentage_change_* to pct_change_*, map price_elasticity_of_demand to absolute_elasticity (the signed price_elasticity is a different figure), map revenue_N to total_revenue_N when the value agrees, drop a key the method no longer emits, and mark expected_refreshed_at.
tests: the eight unemployment/equilibrium cases and economics/elasticity/002 now pass
avoid: leaving a case pinning a removed output
renaming a method output without refreshing its cases
mapping an absolute elasticity onto the signed price_elasticity key

symptom: The tile preview printed Introduction, Scope and Method, Evidence Base, Discussion and an empty References list, while the student's download was a different document.
trigger: Two composers: the conductor outline for the preview and session_paper for the download.
fix: The preview builds the tile record and renders it through session_paper.docx_bytes, the same renderer the download uses: Result, Inputs and results, Assumptions made, Limitations, How the figures were checked.
avoid: keeping two paper composers
printing a References list over an empty corpus

symptom: Generate returned the reasoning model's planning notes as problems ('Need ensure...', 'Problem 1: Narrative with GST?...').
trigger: A reasoning model leaking chain-of-thought into the JSON array.
fix: _looks_like_reasoning and _looks_like_problem drop planning cues and require a complete problem; generate_problems retries when fewer than two survive.
avoid: treating a planning note as a problem
accepting a problem with no declared figure

symptom: Generate solved the problems but left the fix steps to manual clicks; Resolve could be clicked mid-run.
trigger: No busy state around the generate/solve/fix chain.
fix: Generate runs generate -> solve -> propose -> apply -> resolve; healBusy guards Resolve/Dismiss/Propose/Apply with a wait notification.
tests: manual: Resolve during healBusy made no request
avoid: letting a manual close overtake an in-flight run
stopping after generation without the fix steps

symptom: The OpenCode Go websearch provider always returned nothing: the headless session was terminated the moment it printed the websearch tool call, before the tool returned its results.
trigger: The read loop broke on the tool_use line, which carries the call and not the output.
fix: The loop reads to the end of the session; the completed tool state carries the output.
avoid: stopping a provider at the tool call instead of at the tool result
treating an empty provider answer as an empty search

symptom: The provider returned nothing because the parser read the older plain-text shape (Title:/URL:) while the websearch tool now answers in JSON.
trigger: The tool changed its output format and the parser was pinned to the old one.
fix: The parser reads the JSON shape and the older text shape; both are covered.
avoid: pinning a parser to one provider's answer shape
dropping an answer because the shape changed

symptom: Every OpenCode answer came from the open web and was then discarded by the curated site filter, so the provider looked as if it had found nothing.
trigger: The provider had no site parameter, so the site filter was never given to it.
fix: The site's domains go into the prompt, the way the other providers carry them in the query.
avoid: assuming a provider carries the site filter when it has no site parameter
reading a curated filter as proof that the search found nothing

symptom: One rate-limited search poisoned the cache for its whole TTL: the next caller was told the source had nothing without anyone asking it again.
trigger: The cache stored a payload whose providers had all refused, exactly as it stores an answer.
fix: A search every provider refused is not cached; only a search that came back empty is.
avoid: caching a provider's refusal as its answer
reading a cached empty result as evidence
